objective: Measure the K1, K8 bank-coissue, and K1x8 equal-peak-bandwidth raw4-to-Acc24 functional tops under one 28 nm 3 ns pre-macro DC/STA flow.
functional_scope: accepted header/raw4 through accepted signed Acc24 result and token_done
excluded_scope: BN2, SN2, requantization, FC1, complete FFN and full network
clock tree, placement, routing and package IO
fairness_limitations: This first diagnostic synthesizes the existing functional tops; M342 exposes a bundled transaction boundary while M349 exposes eight scalar bank endpoints.
Both points require the same eight 1R x 128-bit physical weight-bank capacity, but the macros are excluded from this run.
Debug conservation counters remain observable in both frozen tops; a later wrapper must prune them symmetrically before paper PPA.
No area or energy claim is paper-admissible until a canonical bank wrapper, explicit context storage model, Formality, and matched SAIF/PTPX are complete.
forbidden_claims: K8 is 5.281x faster than K1 at equal bandwidth
block-sum area ratios are measured integrated area efficiency
pre-macro ideal-clock ZeroWireload results are paper PPA
standalone FC2 results are complete-FFN or system speedup
